# Effort report: p-limit work, Q1 2026

**Contributor:** Elif Demir
**Period:** 1 January to 31 March 2026 (Istanbul time)

## Summary

| Measure | Q1 2026 |
|---|---|
| Commits made | 5 |
| Active working hours | 5 h 50 min (about 5.8 hours) |

## What the figures cover

**Commits.** Five commits on the p-limit project were made in the period, judged by the date each was written, in Istanbul time. They cover cancellation support, tests for it, a written usage recipe, a bug fix for cleaning up after cancellation, and release-note preparation. None were merges, reversals or formatting-only changes.

One further commit, a priority-queue feature, was written at 01:30 on 1 April Istanbul time. It falls just outside the quarter and is not counted.

**Hours.** Hours are taken from timestamps in the exported work sessions on this project. Only active time is counted: whenever there was a gap of more than 30 minutes between two entries, that gap was treated as a break and left out. Where two sessions ran at the same time, the overlap is counted once. A session that ran past midnight on 31 March was cut off at the end of the quarter, so only the part inside the period is counted.

## Not counted

- Sessions on an unrelated client project, because they are not p-l
